nodes.description: bytes32 internal keyHash: VRF key hash used when requesting randomness.
uint256 internal fee: amount of LINK paid per VRF request (2 * 10 ** 18).
uint256 public NUMBER_OF_PARTICIPANTS = 17953, modulus used to derive randomResult.
uint256 public randomResult: final random number in [1, NUMBER_OF_PARTICIPANTS].
uint public times = 0: counter enforcing that randomness is requested only once.
address public owner (from Owned): privileged address.
address private pendingOwner (from Owned): proposed new owner.
LinkTokenInterface immutable internal LINK: LINK token used for VRF fees.
address immutable private vrfCoordinator: only address allowed to fulfil randomness.
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private nonces: per-keyHash VRF request counter.
Constructor of OVRChainlinkCompetition: sets keyHash and fee, invokes VRFConsumerBase constructor.
Constructor of VRFConsumerBase: assigns vrfCoordinator and LINK from arguments.
public onlyOwner onlyOneTime function that checks LINK balance, increments times and calls requestRandomness.
internal override callback that computes randomResult = (randomness % NUMBER_OF_PARTICIPANTS) + 1.
receive() external payable: plain ETH receiving fallback.
internal function of VRFConsumerBase: transfers LINK fee, builds VRF seed and returns the requestId.
external function called by VRFCoordinator; verifies msg.sender and forwards to fulfillRandomness.
internal pure helper hashing keyHash, userSeed, requester and nonce into a seed.
internal pure helper hashing keyHash and VRF input seed into a request id.
external onlyOwner function proposing a new owner by setting pendingOwner.
external function completing ownership transfer when called by pendingOwner.
modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
modifier requiring times == 0, allowing the randomness request only once.
External call LINK.transferAndCall(vrfCoordinator, _fee, data) made from requestRandomness.
times += 1 inside getRandomNumber, unchecked arithmetic on a uint256 counter.
(randomness % NUMBER_OF_PARTICIPANTS) + 1 assignment, unchecked arithmetic that can overflow.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used in ownership and coordinator checks.

edges.reason: getRandomNumber is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares untrusted msg.sender against owner.
owner is the trusted address used in the onlyOwner check.
getRandomNumber is guarded by the onlyOneTime modifier.
onlyOneTime reads times to enforce a single randomness request.
getRandomNumber reads the LINK balance via LINK.balanceOf.
fee is compared against the LINK balance inside getRandomNumber.
getRandomNumber executes the times increment operation.
times += 1 writes the times state variable without overflow protection.
getRandomNumber calls requestRandomness(keyHash, fee).
keyHash state variable is passed into requestRandomness.
fee state variable is passed into requestRandomness.
requestRandomness performs an external call LINK.transferAndCall before updating nonces.
transferAndCall is invoked on the LINK token interface state variable.
requestRandomness calls makeVRFInputSeed to build the VRF seed.
requestRandomness reads the nonces mapping for the current keyHash.
The nonces[_keyHash] value is used as the _nonce argument of makeVRFInputSeed.
requestRandomness calls makeRequestId to derive the request id.
Local vRFSeed is passed to makeRequestId as _vRFInputSeed.
rawFulfillRandomness compares msg.sender with vrfCoordinator.
Untrusted msg.sender must equal vrfCoordinator to pass the require in rawFulfillRandomness.
rawFulfillRandomness invokes the fulfillRandomness callback that mutates randomResult.
fulfillRandomness writes the randomResult state variable.
fulfillRandomness performs the modulo and addition operation for randomResult.
The unchecked modulo + 1 expression assigns into randomResult and can overflow.
NUMBER_OF_PARTICIPANTS is used as the modulus in the randomResult computation.
transferOwnership writes the pendingOwner state variable.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership requires untrusted msg.sender to equal pendingOwner.
pendingOwner is read in the acceptOwnership authorization require.
acceptOwnership writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
requestRandomness consumes its _keyHash parameter.
requestRandomness consumes its _fee parameter.
requestRandomness returns the requestId local variable.
getRandomNumber returns the requestId local variable.
fulfillRandomness consumes its requestId parameter.
fulfillRandomness consumes its randomness parameter.
transferOwnership uses its _to parameter as the new pending owner.
acceptOwnership stores the previous owner into oldOwner before reassigning.
